defects.description: The translation includes extraneous English meta‑commentary that is not present in the source.
The paragraph about the primary output artifact (structured consensus document) is omitted.
The sentence "All artifacts produced by Council are written in technical English." is missing.
The Out of Scope section is rendered as a single summary sentence instead of the original bullet list, altering the content.
defects.quote: Эти возможности могут быть реализованы поверх Council, но они не являются частью его базовой архитектуры.
